candidates.change_summary: Change the final returned value from true to false.
Return the success of the last low-level call instead of a constant true (could differ when calls succeed/fail but overall didn't revert).
Replace require(_tos.length > 0); with require(_tos.length >= 0); so the empty _tos array is accepted and loop runs zero times, changing observable behavior for calls with empty _tos.
Change require(_s); to require(!_s); so calls to target caddress that previously had to succeed must now fail, altering observable behavior when inner calls succeed or fail.
Change the loop condition i<_tos.length to i<=_tos.length so the loop may attempt an out-of-bounds access, altering behavior for non-empty _tos.
Replace bytes4 id = bytes4(keccak256(...)) with bytes4(0); so the selector becomes zero, changing which function is invoked on caddress and observable outcomes.
